descriptors.concept_name: Restatement Of Previously Reported Interim Periods
descriptors.definition: Changes in accounting policies are incorporated by restating prior interim periods of the current and comparable prior financial years. If determining the cumulative effect is impracticable, the new policy is applied prospectively from the earliest date practicable.
inclusion: Restatement of prior interim financial statements of the current financial year
Restatement of comparable interim periods of prior financial years
exclusion: Changes where transition is specifically prescribed by a new Ind AS
nearby_distinctions: Retrospective restatement versus prospective application when cumulative effects cannot be determined.

descriptors.definition: Goodwill impairment losses recognized in previous interim periods cannot be reversed in subsequent reporting periods even if conditions improve. Entities must recognize expenses incurred during an interim period within that same period rather than deferring them.
inclusion: Prohibition of goodwill impairment loss reversals
Recognition of interim expenses in the period incurred
exclusion: Deferral of bad debts or exceptional losses to subsequent quarters
Reversal of impairment losses for goodwill
nearby_distinctions: Distinguishes between mandatory current period expense recognition and improper inter-quarter cost deferrals.

descriptors.concept_name: Significant Differences In Ind As 34 Vis-À-Vis AS 25
descriptors.definition: Ind AS 34 introduces specific disclosure requirements for significant events, prohibits goodwill and certain asset impairment reversals, and contains Appendix A for impairment interactions. Unlike prior standards, it neither mandates nor prohibits including separate parent statements alongside consolidated interim statements.
inclusion: Impairment loss reversal prohibitions for specific assets
Provisions regarding separate and consolidated interim statements
exclusion: Identical accounting treatments across both standards
Annual financial statement frameworks outside interim reporting scope
nearby_distinctions: Contrasts Ind AS 34 requirements with AS 25 concerning impairment reversals and financial statement inclusions.
